criteria.claim: Safety: every neural run completes its 30 s without being stopped
and ECHO decides at most 1% of its samples (fallbacks)
Escape is produced, not only predicted: at least 90% of neural-selected escape commands in the looms become escapes
Feeding is produced: at least 90% of neural-selected feeding commands on the fruit become feeding bouts
Discrimination in closed loop: the selected readout escapes harmless objects no more often than the merged one
and still escapes at least 75% of the threats that begin while it is perched
Exploratory: every arm against ECHO alone on escapes, false alarms, feeding time and meals
